title: PAR-134 SECTION_SETTINGS geometry CMC retention and DXF schema correction
mode: generated AC1024 DWG round-trip and focused ASCII/Binary DXF fast slice
scope: Retain per-geometry DWG CMC method, flags, reserved index, color name, and color-book name through SECTION_SETTINGS parse/model/rewrite
Preflight every SECTION_SETTINGS geometry color before DWG output
Align typed DXF color output with Autodesk Section Geometry Settings group-63 schema and refuse unsupported projections

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: The generic R2004+ CMC envelope contains a reserved BS index, packed method/value, RC optional-name flags, and optional color-name/book TV strings. The existing SECTION_SETTINGS field order was left unchanged; only decoded color metadata retention and inverse writing were changed.

autodeskSectionGeometryDxf.finding: The class-specific Section Geometry Settings DXF reference assigns color data to group 63 and lists no truecolor group 420 or color-name/book groups. The typed writer therefore emits scalar color as group 63 and refuses RGB/names/books and other non-projectable DWG CMC state.

localCode.finding: The bounded DWG reader consumed CMC fields but retained only normalized ACI/RGB. The DWG encoder wrote normalized index/RGB, dropping CMC provenance. The typed DXF parser/writer used group 62 and 420 although the class-specific Autodesk reference lists group 63 only.

productionSummary: Append source method, flags, reserved index, color name, and book name to DRW_SectionGeometrySettings; the public struct size changes and consumers must rebuild.

Capture full CMC output in bounded DWG parsing and replay supported C0-C3 CMC, including flagged-empty strings, after validating color/method consistency, reserved index, flags, name bounds, and detached-string availability before output.
Emit SECTION_SETTINGS typed DXF color only as scalar group 63; refuse RGB, names/books, any source flags, nonzero index, unsupported methods, and inconsistent state before writing.
Read documented group 63 and retain group 62 as a compatibility alias; continue reading legacy group 420 but refuse to re-emit RGB because the class-specific schema has no mapping.
Replace a stale local MLINESTYLE broad-test expectation for now-supported C2 RGB with unsupported C5 method refusal.

generatedControls.dwgRoundTrip: A generated AC1024 SECTION_SETTINGS object carries a named RGB C2 color, book-only C1 color, and flagged-empty C0 name through the production writer and parser. The test checks retained scalar/RGB/method/flags/index/names and copy/assignment.
generatedControls.failClosed: Generated writer cases reject unsupported C5, nonzero reserved index, unknown flags, a book value inconsistent with flags, and out-of-range RGB while preserving an existing destination.
generatedControls.dxfProjection: ASCII and Binary controls admit scalar ACI output as group 63 and verify that group 62/420 is not emitted. They reject RGB, names/books, flagged-empty metadata, nonzero reserved index, C5, and method/scalar disagreement before output.
generatedControls.dxfParsing: A focused parser control reads documented group 63 and verifies the historical group-62 local alias remains accepted.

evidenceLimits: Generated controls establish local writer/parser consistency, not independent producer semantics.
The generic ODA CMC layout was used without changing SECTION_SETTINGS body field order; no native SECTION_SETTINGS producer was exercised.
Autodesk's class-specific DXF schema does not document Section Geometry Settings truecolor/name/book groups; the writer refuses these projections rather than inferring mappings.
No persistent fixture, native CAD application, independent semantic route, full test suite, platform qualification, or support promotion was used.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
The public DRW_SectionGeometrySettings size increases; downstream consumers must rebuild. The shared worktree is dirty and this slice is uncommitted.
